semantic_fixtures.covers: The exact Koya ability owner compiles in Ability context with its optional singleton target group, Creature-excluding-Source filter, outer instruction order, delayed child, and full child owner path.
The owner-specific Exile producer accepts an arbitrary result name or a deliberately discarded result.
The profile rejects a different owner, target maximum or filter, delayed subject or timing, unknown or wrong-type input, and a nonadjacent producer.
Koya's resolved optional-target ability completes with no ExiledObject and creates no delayed observer; Koya itself is not a legal target.
A chosen target that leaves before resolution makes the targeted ability fizzle before the Exile producer, so no delayed observer is created.
The parent ability resolves after Koya leaves and the observer captures the target's exact post-Exile generation and controller.
The observer exists before the declared commander's owner chooses Command; declining at the next end step does not return it from Command.
The delayed child returns the exact exiled card to the battlefield under its owner when payment is declined.
Paying the delayed cost leaves the exact exiled card in Exile.
A token target is watched through its exact Exile generation and still creates the delayed payment choice after the token ceases to exist.
